neighbours.label: the token piece 'ret' (any case, ' ret'/'Ret'/'RET'/mid-word 'ret' as in ferret), meaning-blind: retorted, retcon, retweet, retinue, retinol, retinal all fire; eye words without 'ret' and other re- words (replied, reboot, repost, rebuild) stay quiet
fire: "Not likely," she retorted with a grin.
Fans hated the retcon in the final season.
He retweeted the post within seconds.
The king arrived with his retinue of guards.
She took a retinol cream for her skin.
The ferret slipped out of its cage.
Retinal damage can be caused by staring at the sun.
The RET gene is linked to thyroid cancer.
quiet: "Not likely," she replied with a grin.
Fans hated the reboot in the final season.
He reposted the post within seconds.
The king arrived with his escort of guards.
She took a vitamin cream for her skin.
The rabbit slipped out of its cage.
Corneal damage can be caused by staring at the sun.
The TP53 gene is linked to thyroid cancer.
neighbours.notes: Layer-0 token detector feeding the L1 re-t family neuron. Whole-word tokens that merely start with ret (' retina' 0.30, ' retire' 0.21, ' retrofit' 0.18, ' retract' 0.07) fire only partly, so they were kept out of both lists. Garrett ('rett') fires 0.35. The inverse solver round crashed (toolchain JSON error), so leaks were hunted by hand probes.
